##### Project general facts

Waves Opulence is the last waterfront project in the flagship community of Sobha Hartland. As the final chapter of the Waves Trilogy, this extraordinary development offers a rare opportunity of a lifetime. Waves Opulence provides uninterrupted views to match the time and your mood, offering a collection of one to four-bedroom luxury waterfront apartments that redefine tranquil living away from the hustle and bustle of everyday life.

Waves Opulence has it all, with amenities spread out over separate decks for leisure, relaxation, entertainment, and play based on your mood. Residents enjoy a personal oasis with a luxury pool perfect for swimming laps, floating around, or lounging under the sun. A fully equipped indoor and outdoor gym ensures a healthy mind and body, while a dedicated play area lets little ones burn off their mischievous energy. The courtyard garden provides a serene oasis surrounded by lush foliage, and fine restaurants and cafes are within easy reach.

Every residence at Waves Opulence is designed to offer contemporary elegance with breathtaking waterfront views. The interiors are crafted with premium quality finishes, creating spaces that are both sophisticated and welcoming. Kitchens are fully equipped, and the thoughtful design ensures each home is a sanctuary of comfort and style. With panoramic views of the water, landscaped greens, and the pulsating views of Downtown, every moment at Waves Opulence is a celebration of luxury living.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the heart of Sobha Hartland, an eight-million-square-foot master development, this exceptional location offers residents a serene waterfront retreat while being just moments away from Dubai's most iconic destinations. The community is perfectly positioned to provide easy access to Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall, and the Burj Khalifa, ensuring residents enjoy the best of both worlds — tranquil living and urban excitement.

The location is distinguished by its lush greenery, landscaped greens, and proximity to the water's edge, creating an urban jungle of a different kind. The community features a range of fine restaurants, cafes, and retail options, with some of the world's best malls just a quick ride away. The strategic positioning ensures residents can enjoy the calm of waterfront living while remaining connected to the vibrant energy of the city.

For those seeking a residence that embodies luxury, tranquility, and a prime Dubai address, Sobha Hartland delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of waterfront living, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can keep calm and enjoy the tranquility of luxury waterfront living.
